objective.text: Run chained jobs in order and stop downstream work after an unhandled job failure.

difficulty.rationale: Trace sequential dependencies rather than treating a chain as independent batch work.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A chain contains Prepare, Render and Publish. Prepare succeeds. Render throws and is ultimately marked failed without a recovery dispatch. Which normal chain behavior follows?

options.text: Publish runs before Render is retried so the chain can finish sooner.
options.rationale: A successor does not bypass the failure of its prerequisite.
options.misconception: A successor does not bypass the failure of its prerequisite.

options.text: Publish is not dispatched by the chain.
options.rationale: The queued handler dispatches the next chained job only after successful processing of the current one.

options.text: Prepare is automatically rolled back even though it already completed.
options.rationale: A chain is not a distributed transaction that undoes earlier job side effects.
options.misconception: A chain is not a distributed transaction that undoes earlier job side effects.

options.text: Publish runs immediately because the chain was fully enqueued at the start.
options.rationale: The normal chain advances one successful step at a time rather than queueing every successor independently.
options.misconception: The normal chain advances one successful step at a time rather than queueing every successor independently.
